# Commissioning and handover checklist

Use this as a documentation and coordination prompt, adapted by the responsible qualified commissioning team and venue. It is not a method statement, electrical safety procedure, rigging inspection standard, or approval checklist.

## Before commissioning
- [ ] Approved current drawings, schedules, design basis, and revision list are available.
- [ ] Equipment inventory matches installed model, quantity, options, firmware, and accessories; discrepancies recorded.
- [ ] Exact manufacturer manuals and photometric/control files are archived or linked with revision/date.
- [ ] Qualified electrical and structural/rigging sign-offs or inspection records are provided where required by scope and jurisdiction.
- [ ] Venue permits, access, isolation, work-at-height, exclusion-zone, communications, and emergency procedures are controlled by responsible site personnel.
- [ ] Control network and console backups are saved; sensitive credentials are not placed in public repository documents.
- [ ] Test scope, acceptance criteria, responsible people, and stop/escalation conditions are agreed.

## Functional verification record
Record each test with date, area/device, expected result, observed result, pass/fail, evidence, person responsible, and issue/reference ID.

- [ ] Device identification, addressing, personality/mode, patch, universe, and naming checked against approved schedule.
- [ ] Control output, gateways/nodes, protocol settings, and signal path verified by the system owner.
- [ ] Basic functions and relevant parameters checked on representative and required individual devices.
- [ ] Control-loss/fallback behavior checked only under an approved test plan and with safe conditions.
- [ ] Scenes/cues, operating modes, interfaces, and any emergency-related functions tested by designated responsible parties.
- [ ] Photometric/visual acceptance measurements, if required, performed with documented instrument, calibration, placement, operating state, and criteria source.
- [ ] Defects, deviations, temporary workarounds, and retest status recorded; no workaround bypasses a safety feature.

## Handover package
- [ ] As-built drawings, fixture schedule, patch/universe map, network topology, and revisions.
- [ ] Console/show files, controller/node configuration backups, software/firmware versions, and restore procedure.
- [ ] Product manuals, approved accessory lists, maintenance/access information, and warranties.
- [ ] Test/measurement results, non-conformances, closed/open punch-list items, and acceptance sign-off.
- [ ] Operator/maintainer training, contacts, ownership boundaries, and escalation route.
- [ ] Final review confirms no confidential credentials or unsafe instructions were committed to public files.
